thought.text: All three dev servers are now up (app in watch mode). Let me verify each frontend through the proxy with bounded timeouts (first requests compile on demand).

reasoning_content: The app dev server is up and running (watch mode is enabled). All three dev servers (app, cms, boards) are running. Let's verify that all three are being served through the proxy. The earlier hang was probably because the app's first request triggered on-demand compilation (Vite's dev server compiles on request). Now that the server is warm, let's use a short timeout to quickly check each frontend.

action.command:
for app in app cms boards; do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 120 -H "Host: ${app}.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1:80/ 2>&1)
  echo "${app}.workspace.localhost -> HTTP ${code:-timeout}"
done
